detail.why: V3 selects by trueFP alone. Its stability across identities is a tautology, NOT evidence that the attribution is identity-robust

the-family-table-is-stable-because-V3-ca.note: do not read 'stable under 4 identities' as 'robust'

detail.history: 670/672 printed '66 个名字每档都假阳性' (V2) next to '每档 73-76 格' (V3). They are two different readings of one number.

one-sentence-three-readings-three-tables.note: V1 is the only reading that moves when the identity changes: name 85 / kS 78 / kS2 73 / kS3 77 / kS4 73

detail.mechanism: V1 under the name identity pulls in 12 controls that are NOT true-FP in that cell; their blame is an element with no class, so a family appears that has no counterpart under V3 or under kS4
